newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-TIME TRIAL TRIUMPH FOR OLANO.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-TIME TRIAL TRIUMPH FOR OLANO.

text.p: Abraham Olano finally came up trumps when he won the 20th stage of the Tour de France, a 63-km time trial at Disneyland Paris on Saturday.
The Spaniard, who has had a disappointing Tour, was 45 seconds faster than overall race leader Jan Ullrich who is set to be crowned winner on the Champs Elysees on Sunday.
Olano just failed to snatch third place overall from Italian Marco Pantani who suffered a puncture.
Defending champion Bjane Riis's woes continued when he twice had to change wheels in the opening section. He finished 9:12 adrift of Olano.
The Dane threw his bike into the grass verge in disgust when he realised he needed a second change.
